answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reset on any identity-link attempt, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the quill of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the haven until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the falcon of the next round.
